title: company/v1 doctype frontmatter (AIP-6)
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter portion of a company/v1 doctype file. The discriminator is `doctype`, or its alias `kind`; the identifier is `id`, or its alias `slug`. Both aliases are accepted permanently (AIP-6 sets no removal date for them). Three doctypes are defined here: company, objective, and the legacy agent marker. A ROLE.md is an AIP-47 role/v1 document, an OPERATOR.md is AIP-9, an AGENT.md is AIP-42, and seats and reporting lines live in the AIP-22 office: none of these is validated by this schema.

schema.description: Format identifier. Writers MUST emit the canonical string `company/v1`. `agentcompanies/v1` is accepted as a legacy alias (AIP-70).

doctype.description: Canonical discriminator. Selects the doctype-specific branch under `oneOf`. `agent` is the legacy AIP-6 agent slot marker (see AIP-42 Backward compatibility); the shape of an agent file is AIP-42's, not this schema's. A file MUST carry `doctype` or its alias `kind`.

kind.description: Alias of `doctype`, accepted permanently with no removal date. When a file carries both, they MUST name the same doctype.

id.description: Canonical slug identifier. Lowercase, digits, dashes. Stable across renames; references use this, never database IDs. A file MUST carry `id` or its alias `slug`.

slug.description: Alias of `id`, accepted permanently with no removal date. When a file carries both, they MUST be equal; a JSON Schema cannot compare two values, so a host reports `alias_conflict` itself (ADAPTER.md).

version.description: Spec version of THIS file. Bump on breaking change.

metadata.description: Vendor-specific extensions. Authors stash hints under namespaced keys `metadata.<vendor>.…`; other readers MUST tolerate unknown keys.

mission.description: One-paragraph mission. Read by every operator at boot.

values.description: Short value statements; surfaced in role prompts.

positions.description: DEPRECATED: seats live in the AIP-22 office (AIP-22 An office spans a company tree). Slugs of the company's seats. Readers MUST keep accepting it, with no removal date; when the company has an office, the office is authoritative and this list is only a seed. A position is a seat one operator holds; several positions may share one AIP-47 catalog role.

roles.description: DEPRECATED alias of `positions`, itself deprecated toward the AIP-22 office. Readers MUST accept it, with no removal date; when both are present, `positions` wins. Historically documented as role slugs but used in practice for seats.

objectives.description: Slugs of top-level objectives defined under `objectives/<slug>/OBJECTIVE.md`.

reports_to.description: DEPRECATED: reporting lines live in the AIP-22 office (a seat's `reportsTo`). Map of position-slug to position-slug; the key reports to the value. Readers MUST keep accepting it, with no removal date; the office wins when both exist.

imports.description: External roles or objectives pulled from a registry. Resolved by the adapter at load time. An imported role is materialised as an AIP-47 `role/v1` document.

statement.description: One-paragraph statement of the desired outcome.

owner.description: Slug of the position (an AIP-22 office seat) or of the AIP-47 role accountable for this objective.

horizon.description: Time horizon. Adapter MAY use this to surface stale objectives.

parent.description: Slug of the parent objective (for decomposition trees). Omit for top-level objectives.

children.description: Slugs of child sub-objectives. Adapter validates the parent/children edges agree.

depends_on.description: Slugs of objectives this one depends on.

agent.description: Legacy AIP-6 agent slot (`agents/<id>/AGENT.md` with `schema: company/v1` and `kind: agent`). Only the marker is checked here: the field set of an agent is AIP-42's, and hosts read the file as an AGENT.md (`slug` is its `id`). AIP-42 sets no removal date for this form.

from.description: Source ref. Format: `<registry>/<package>@<version>` or a relative path.

as.description: Imported doctype. A role is materialised as an AIP-47 `role/v1` document, an objective as a company/v1 objective.

id.description: Local slug to bind the import under.

alias.description: Override the import's local slug if it would collide.
